description: Auto-capture every completed Workflow run as readable Markdown. Fires on Stop; the exporter reads only local run journals and self-limits to exactly-once per run, so it never blocks Stop. Output dir follows env precedence ($WF_EXPORT_DIR > $WF_JOURNAL_REPO/workflow-journal > ~/workflow-journal); set $WF_JOURNAL_REPO to also auto commit+push the render.
